descriptions.text: Agility is a basic attribute available to all Avatars. It influences almost every action where coordination, finesse, and grace are involved.

Agility is a basic attribute available to all Avatars. It influences almost every action where coordination, finesse and grace are involved. Agility is defined as being characterized by quickness, lightness, and ease of movement, both physically and mentally. Agility is a very important skill in PE, because it influences the chance of an avatar avoiding mob (monster) hits entirely, rather than lessening the damage or providing more hit points for the mob to work through. It also makes you run faster. Agility is easily gained by being attacked by mobs. Professions: All
Aim is the ability to accurately hit a target with direct fire ranged weapons.

Aim is the ability to accurately hit a target with direct fire ranged weapons. Aim is the ability to effectively hit a foe. This is very important for ranged weapons, such as the pistols and rifles, as damage will not be done at all if the shot misses the enemy. Profession: Hunter

Stamina is a basic attribute available to all Avatars. It influences almost every action where bodily hardiness, constitution, and physical toughness are involved. Stamina is the ability to exert a constant force of work over varying periods of time. Commonly also known as endurance, in PE, stamina determines how long you can hold out during a variety of activities such as running and taking damage. This skill is currently not used. It's always 9.
